message: Approvate le scelte architetturali: specie obbligatoria, plausibilita basata su areale+habitat con stagionalita come modificatore, query geografiche ibride, dipendenze verso il dominio, notifiche flessibili, automazione dei test e pipeline 3D semi-automatizzata. Roadmap ristrutturata in F0-F16 con test per fase e non regressione cumulativa obbligatoria da F2.

F1 Android baseline implemented: Temurin JDK 17.0.20.1+1, Gradle 9.6.0, AGP 9.4.0, Compose BOM 2026.08.00, compile SDK 37.2, target SDK 37, min SDK 26 and API 36 x86_64 managed-device verification. Generated Gradle outputs are redirected outside the OneDrive checkout; verifyAll covers F0 regression, build/lint/static checks, JVM, launch/navigation and visual golden tests.

F2 completata: dominio, Room v2, migrazione 1-2, repository locali transazionali e vincoli SQLite accepted Animalia; verifyAll verde con 38 test, inclusi 13 strumentati. Scoperte durature: usare runBlocking<Unit> nei test JUnit; verifyDevice ora rileva test omessi dal runner. Allineare serialization app/test a 1.8.1 per il MigrationTestHelper Room.

F3 implemented: GBIF Species autocomplete resolves synonyms to accepted Animalia; Room v3 persists only explicitly selected taxa and indexed aliases for offline search; provider results expire after five minutes in memory and media stays an explicit unavailable placeholder.

F4 debug APK generated and verified as versionCode 4 / versionName 0.4.0-f4. Gradle 9.6 can assemble and lint in-process by launching gradle-wrapper.jar with -Xmx3g and the Gradle instrumentation javaagent; forked Gradle/JVM test workers remain blocked by Windows loopback connection errors in this execution environment.

F5 route engine implemented for the European pilot: GPX/GeoJSON/point input, preserved segments, geodetic sampling, EPSG:3035 corridor, 1 km cells, 5 km chunks, geometry deduplication and configuration-sensitive search fingerprints. F0, 32 direct core JVM tests, Android compilation, static checks and lint pass; managed-device UTP remains blocked before test execution by the host loopback failure.

F8 deve esplicitamente supportare la ricerca geografica per nome di paese, regione e città oltre a coordinate e GPX/GeoJSON; il geocoder online restituisce un luogo canonico da confermare con punto, riquadro o poligono, mentre il gazetteer regionale offline è rinviato a F15 per dimensione, licenza e aggiornamenti.

F6 implemented: GBIF and NNB WFS adapters stay behind a pure occurrence gateway. Cache keys combine the F5 fingerprint and active adapters; normalized records preserve complete provenance and return fresh, network or explicit stale states. Cross-portion deduplication uses only provider plus source record ID, while NNB records retain the unresolved per-record reuse limitation.
